It rests on [CLAIM-162](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-162.md), which is Proposed and objected to by [ARG-016](../../../record/arguments.d/ARG-016.md); the analogy that carries it is [ARG-237](../../../record/arguments.d/ARG-237.md). A20 §7 adds that no reported state of flow is shown by coordination. The wording is A's (ChatGPT, in the exchange of 2026-11-22); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
